verse.verse_3: that We sent down during a Blessed Night. We are ever warning.
verse.verse_4: In it every wise matter is determined
verse.verse_5: an order from Us. We are ever sending.
verse.verse_6: A Mercy from your Lord, He is the Hearer, the Knower.
verse.verse_7: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if you are certain (of your faith).
verse.verse_8: There is no god except He. He revives and causes to die. (He is) your Lord and the Lord of your fathers, the ancients.
verse.verse_9: Yet they are in doubt, playing.
verse.verse_10: Watch for the Day when the heaven will bring clear smoke,
verse.verse_11: engulfing the people; this will be a painful punishment.
verse.verse_12: 'Our Lord, remove this punishment from us, we are believers'
verse.verse_13: But how will they avail themselves of the Reminder, when a clear Messenger had already come to them
verse.verse_14: but then they turned away from him, saying: 'He is tutored, mad'
verse.verse_15: We are removing the punishment a little, but you revert.
verse.verse_16: But on that Day We will assault them most mightily, and then We shall revenge!
verse.verse_17: We tried Pharaoh's nation before them. A noble Messenger came to them,
verse.verse_18: (saying:) 'Be obedient to me O worshipers of Allah. I am your honest Messenger.
verse.verse_19: Do not rise up against Allah, I come to you with clear authority.
verse.verse_20: I take refuge with my Lord and your Lord lest you stone me.
verse.verse_21: And if you do not believe me, then leave me'
verse.verse_22: Then he supplicated to his Lord saying: 'These are sinful people'
verse.verse_23: (His Lord answered): 'Set out with My worshipers in the night, for you will surely be followed.
verse.verse_24: Then leave the sea calm they are an army that will be drowned.
verse.verse_25: How many gardens and fountains did they leave behind,
verse.verse_26: and sown fields, fine sitting places,
verse.verse_27: and good things in which they took delight.
verse.verse_28: As such (it was). And We made other people inherit them.
verse.verse_29: Neither heaven nor earth shed tears for them; nor were they respited,
verse.verse_30: and We saved the Children of Israel from a humiliating punishment
verse.verse_31: from Pharaoh, who ranked high in sin,
verse.verse_32: and We chose them, out of a knowledge above the nations (of their time).
verse.verse_33: And gave signs to them in which there was a clear trial.
verse.verse_35: 'There is nothing except the first death, we shall never be revived.
verse.verse_36: Bring us our fathers, if what you say is true'
verse.verse_37: Are they better or the people of Tubba' and those who were before them whom We destroyed? Indeed they were sinners.
verse.verse_38: It was not in play that We created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them.
verse.verse_39: We created them in nothing else except the truth. But most do not know.
verse.verse_40: The Day of Decision is the appointed time for all.
verse.verse_41: On that Day no cousin shall help his cousin and they shall not be helped
verse.verse_42: except those on whom Allah will have mercy. He is the Almighty, the Most Merciful.
verse.verse_43: The food of the Zakkum tree
verse.verse_44: shall be the food of the guilty sinners.
verse.verse_45: Like molten copper boiling in the belly
verse.verse_46: as the boiling of the hot water.
verse.verse_47: 'Seize him and drag him into the center of Hell.
verse.verse_48: Then pour the punishment of boiling water over his head,
verse.verse_49: (Saying): 'Taste, surely you are the mighty and noble!
verse.verse_50: This is that which you doubted'
verse.verse_51: Indeed, for those who feared (Allah) is a secure place
verse.verse_53: dressed in silks and brocade, set face to face.
verse.verse_54: As such, We shall wed them to wideeyed houris (the virgins of Paradise).
verse.verse_55: There in security, they will call for every kind of fruit.
verse.verse_56: There they shall not taste death, except the first death, and He will shield them from the punishment of Hell,
verse.verse_57: as a bounty from your Lord. That will be the mighty triumph.
verse.verse_58: We have now made it easy on your tongue, in order that they remember.
verse.verse_59: So be watchful, they too are watching.
